title: Attacking full back being tracked
metric_definition: Full back roles are LB, RB, LWB, and RWB from the match json, not from the event position. The run is an off_ball_run with subtype overlap or underlap. Candidate frames are every 0.5 s from frame_start through frame_end, plus the temporal midpoint. The measurement frame is the candidate in the attacking half (attack-normalized tracking x > 0) closest to that midpoint, among candidates with a velocity window. Tracked means all three at that frame: the nearest outfield opponent is within 6 m, that opponent is goal-side (closer to the goal being attacked), and the two velocities are similar over the previous 1.0 s. Similar velocity: cosine of the displacements >= 0.60 and speed difference <= 2.0 m/s. If both players move under 1 m in the window, similar means the speeds differ by at most 1.5 m/s. A missing velocity window excludes the run. It is not labelled untracked. Runs that never enter the attacking half are excluded. Outcomes on the same event are received, lead_to_shot, and xthreat. xG is not used. The effect is the pooled mean for tracked runs minus untracked runs. The interval resamples matches (2000 draws, percentile 2.5 to 97.5). A contrast is supported only when that interval excludes zero.
population: full-back overlap and underlap off_ball_run while in the attacking half
notes: Prevention would show a negative effect: tracked runs received less often, lead to a shot less often, and carry lower xthreat. An interval above zero is still a separation. It means the tracked runs are the more dangerous ones. Support uses only whether the match-clustered interval excludes zero.
